mappings.note: Part (i) is one factor for selecting the most appropriate transfer-pricing method: the nature and class of the international transaction. No candidate descriptor covers this method-selection factor.
Part (ii) concerns the associated-enterprise classes, functions, assets, and risks relevant to selecting a transfer-pricing method. No candidate descriptor covers this factor analysis.
Part (iii) tests whether reliable data needed to apply a transfer-pricing method is available; the supplied candidates do not describe this method-selection criterion.

Part (iv) tests comparability of the controlled international transaction, uncontrolled transaction, and enterprises for selecting a transfer-pricing method. No candidate descriptor addresses this comparability factor.
Part (v) concerns whether reliable, accurate comparability adjustments can be made when choosing a transfer-pricing method. No supplied candidate covers that criterion.
Part (vi) concerns the reliability of assumptions required to apply a transfer-pricing method. The available candidates do not cover this method-selection factor.
